pages.title: Wilderness predators
pages.text: Rare Darkbats hunt outside cities and dungeon grounds, circling overhead before diving in powerful melee sweeps. They attack on sight even if you are well rested.$(br2)Daylight and torches do not prevent spawns; sunlight does not burn them. Natural spawning stops at three nearby Darkbats per player by default (server configurable). Watch the open sky and use solid cover when one dives.

pages.title: Watch the sky
pages.text: Soldiers defend complexes on foot. Combat Drones attack from the air. Sentinel Drones watch for intruders and can raise the city’s alert.$(br2)Keep cover between yourself and observers. A working Scramble helmet module helps avoid sentinel detection, but fighting defenders can still raise an alert.

pages.title: Natural patrols
pages.text: Soldiers and occasional Master Soldiers spawn in city biomes and inside every dungeon type, including underground halls and the huge cube.$(br2)They can spawn at light levels of 11 or lower. Light rooms to 12 or higher to prevent these natural spawns.$(br2)Natural patrols follow normal hostile spawning distances and mob caps. They do not need an alert or the whole dungeon loaded, and can still appear after its AI is defeated.

pages.title: Prepare for lethal hits
pages.text: A soldier with a sabre can kill an unarmored player in one hit, even on Easy. Full netherite can withstand one melee hit, including from stronger foot guards.$(br2)Combat Drones at advanced bases are more dangerous: a single laser hit can kill through unenchanted netherite. Use cover and protective enchantments before alerting them.

pages.title: Lance wielders
pages.text: Some soldiers and guards carry a longer Energy Lance with both hands. They fire lasers instead of closing for a sabre strike.$(br2)Their lasers deal 30% more raw damage than their sabres. Use walls and cover, especially at advanced bases.$(br2)Lances and matching Constructor blueprints can be found rarely in Storage Cubes. Keep your off hand empty when firing a captured lance.

pages.title: Master Soldiers
pages.text: Master Soldiers are tough, regenerate health, and resist fire and magic. Bring a reliable weapon and a retreat plan.$(br2)An Enhanced Energy Sabre with a working Inhibit module suppresses their regeneration and strips beneficial effects. Fire alone will not solve this fight.$(br2)Check your modules and both fuel supplies before engaging.
